disclosures.text: A motion assistance apparatus
a proximal frame configured to support a proximal part of a user
a connecting frame rotatably connected to the proximal frame
a distal frame rotatably connected to the connecting frame
the distal frame configured to support a distal part of the user
a power transmitter including a slider, a pusher and a coupler
the slider configured to slide along the proximal frame
the pusher rotatably connected to the distal frame and the slider
the coupler configured to rotatably connect the slider and the pusher
in a whole range of motion of the coupler, the coupler remains closer to the proximal part of the user than to a rotation axis of the connecting frame
A motion assistance apparatus comprising: a proximal frame configured to support a proximal part of a user
a distal frame configured to support a distal part of the user
a connecting frame rotatably connected to each of the proximal frame and the distal frame
the connecting frame is configured to rotate in a direction so as to be parallel to the proximal frame
this rotation occurs in response to the proximal frame rotating in a direction in which an angle between the proximal frame and the distal frame increases
a power transmitter configured to transmit a power from the proximal frame to the distal frame
the power transmitter includes a slider connected to an end of a pusher via a coupler
the pusher is configured to rotate in 2 degrees of freedom (DOF) with respect to the slider

A motion assistance apparatus comprising: a proximal frame supporting a proximal part of a user; a connecting frame rotatably connected to the proximal frame; a distal frame rotatably connected to the connecting frame and supporting a dista
the power transmitter and connecting frame connect the distal frame and the proximal frame
the distal frame performs a 2-degree of freedom (DOF) motion with respect to the proximal frame
the 2-DOF motion includes a motion traversing a sagittal plane of the user
the connecting frame rotates to urge itself parallel to the proximal frame
this rotation occurs when the distal frame rotates to increase an extension angle between the distal frame and the proximal frame
the apparatus increases an extension angle between the distal frame and the proximal frame
this increase occurs when the slider slides toward the distal part of the user
a restraint connected to the distal frame
the restraint overlaps the proximal frame when viewed from a side of the user
a cam configured to protrude from the proximal frame to support the restraint
the cam has a first end and a second end
a height of the cam varies from the first end to the second end
a rotary body rotatably connected to the proximal frame
a wire configured to connect the rotary body and the slider
the distal frame comprises a first segment frame connected to the connecting frame
the distal frame comprises a second segment frame angle-adjustably connected to the first segment frame
a driving elastic body connects the proximal frame and the slider
the driving elastic body provides an elastic force to push the slider toward the distal part of the user
an auxiliary elastic body connects the proximal frame and the connecting frame
the distal frame is in rolling contact with the connecting frame
a thigh-wearable portion connected to the proximal frame
the thigh-wearable portion is worn on a thigh of the user
a shank-wearable portion connected to the distal frame
the shank-wearable portion is worn on a shank of the user
the slider is configured to slide along the proximal frame
the pusher is rotatably connected to the distal frame and the slider
the distal frame performs a 2-DOF motion with respect to the proximal frame
